name: pstore_observability

collector.rationale: The safeguard installs the Linux pstore collector executable.

budget.rationale: Durable state storage budget measured and governed on 2026-08-05; the byte ceiling prevents unbounded growth without permitting automatic deletion.

systemd_service.rationale: The safeguard installs the Linux pstore collector service.

systemd_timer.rationale: The safeguard installs the Linux pstore collector timer.

storage.rationale: Linux-only system configuration and executable files are verified by the safeguard file check.

description: Export privileged pstore crash artifacts into a Vrooli read-only host-observability directory for unprivileged scenarios
